test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym for the word provided in the bracket to fill in the blank.

The professor delivered a _______________ lecture on quantum physics. (simplified)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Complex**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**simplified**" means made easier to understand or less complicated.
 
• The antonym of "**simplified**" is "**complex**," which means intricate or complicated.
 
• A "**complex**" lecture would typically involve detailed and advanced concepts, which contrasts with a "**simplified**" one.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The professor delivered a complex__ lecture on quantum physics.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Refined**: means elegant or polished.
 
• **Plain**: means simple or ordinary.
 
• **Lengthy**: means extended in duration or wordiness.
 
• **Complex**: means intricate or complicated.
